name: Aye Finance Ltd
title: Aye Finance Ltd - 544699 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Aye Finance is a micro-MSME NBFC where credit costs fell for a fifth straight quarter to 4.3% and PAR X improved to 6.9%, but FY27 guidance of 3.5–4% credit cost and 25–30% AUM growth is management's own framing rather than hard supply evidence.

triggers.label: Credit costs 4.67% → 4.3% (5th straight cut)
triggers.quote: Credit costs also reduced to 4.3% in quarter 4 compared to 4.67% in previous quarter, which is a 37 basis points reduction quarter-on-quarter.

triggers.label: Borrowing cost to fall 25–35 bps in FY27
triggers.quote: we do expect a borrowing cost to reduce by 25 to 35 basis points compared to FY27.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursements up 26% QoQ to ₹1,655 cr
triggers.quote: disbursements for quarter 4 grew at 26% sequentially to INR1,655 crores of disbursement in the quarter.

triggers.label: Mortgage PAR 90 at 2.7%, rising
triggers.quote: the PAR 90 for the mortgage today is about 2.7% of the total portfolio. This has increased compared to the December quarter.

guidance.value: 25 to 35 bps (later corrected to ~30 bps from 10.87%)

red_flags.label: Mortgage PAR 90 rising to 2.7%
red_flags.quote: the PAR 90 for the mortgage today is about 2.7% of the total portfolio. This has increased compared to the December quarter.

red_flags.label: Credit cost guidance relies on NPA pool resolution
red_flags.quote: The other big piece is the settlement part of the resolution that we will focus on.

red_flags.label: Fair value gains flattering Q4 non-interest income
red_flags.quote: the fair value change that you are seeing is primarily driven on two aspects.

evasions.topic: Sustainability of Q4 fair value gains
evasions.quote: we intend to move it down to OCI because that is where the real line is
